verdict: GO for finite source-composition integration of the reviewed hover borders
review_method: Inspected all 71 before/after native-scale states in the v1 Noxus and Piltover comparison sheets.
Inspected enlarged exact candidate images for Noxus mageGuild4 and shipyard, and Piltover castle, cityHall and mageGuild3.
Independently compared v1 and v2 manifest border hashes: only Noxus mageGuild4, ship and shipyard changed.
Inspected each of those three exact v2 after.png images enlarged five times in memory.
resolved_findings: Noxus mageGuild4 no longer follows the rectangular sky crop above the tower.
Noxus ship and shipyard now follow their dock, piers and vessel instead of the rectangular water image.
Piltover castle and cityHall retain visible painted sky outside the gold contour; that retained painting is not itself an outline defect.
visual_assessment: The reviewed borders have consistent moderate gold edges and dark support; no additional concrete architectural-contour defect was observed in this finite review.
limitations: This approves only source-composition use of the exact reviewed hover-border candidates.
Existing paintings retain their scenery and crop boundaries; this review does not accept or repaint those paintings.
Native hover occlusion, input selection, construction transitions and scaling were not executed or observed by this reviewer.
No general artwork, gameplay, package, rights or release acceptance is granted.
